synopsis: They were childhood friends, and she had always been more powerful than him. But when they accidentally traveled (summoned?) to another world, it was finally time for him to become the knight in shining armor! He had to find her first though, since they were separated... Come and witness his fight to be better in a crazy world where monsters roamed and technology was so advanced your amputated limbs be restored to perfection... (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Mogura no Uta
synopsis: Tanibukuro city's Officer Kikukawa Reiji is the problem child of the police force. He doesn't always follow protocol and he enforces justice through his own personal morals. But it was that exact unwavering sense of righteousness that convinced the chief of police that Reiji was a perfect fit for a top secret undercover mission. He is given the task of infiltrating the Sukiya organization, the biggest and most dangerous mafia group of the Kanto region, and find solid evidence to arrest its leader Todoroki Shuho. But being accepted and trusted in the mafia means Reiji has to do unthinkable things and put himself in dangerous situations where one little slip and his life would be over. (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: Bing Ruo Meimei Zong Shi Xiao Xiang Wo
titleRomaji: Bing Ruo Meimei Zong Shi Xiao Xiang Wo
synonyms: My Sickly Sister Always Misses Me
synopsis: Xu Yulian is the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, smart and beautiful. Her life should've been a smooth ride, until she ran into a stumbling block named "Xu Wenjiao." Her sister came out of nowhere and became the person she hates the most. When she was a child, the frail Xu Wenjiao occupied all of her mother's time and attention. After she grew up, Xu Yulian had a crush on the neighbor girl who had just returned from studying abroad. But before she could get up the courage, she saw the girl confess to Xu Wenjiao instead. In this house, it's going to be either her or Xu Wenjiao, one or the other. Xu Yulian got so angry that she actually packed her bags to leave home, but her sister, who always seemed so weak and frail, suddenly grabbed her by the wrist wrist and pushed her into the corner. Xu Wenjiao looked at her jealously and whispered in her ear: "Sister, why do you like her but not me?" Xu Yulian blushed, "Xu Wenjiao, are you crazy? Have you been reading too many bad romance novels to be acting this way?" (Source: Bilibili, translated)
